slides.texte_overlay:
what people think ADHD is
vs
what it actually feels like

what people think
"they're just hyper"

what it feels like
being exhausted and restless
at the exact same time

what people think
"they never listen"

what it feels like
listening so hard
to not miss anything
that you miss everything

what people think
"they're so spontaneous"

what it feels like
your brain said yes
before you even
heard the question

what people think
"they're just disorganised"

what it feels like
having 4 systems, 3 notebooks
and still no idea
where that one paper is

what people think
"they have so much energy"

what it feels like
running at full speed
until you crash for 2 days

what people think
"they don't care"

what it feels like
caring so much it's loud,
and still falling behind
